title: Capstone: Nightly Fraud Screening
description: Capstone: retrain an H2O fraud model every night behind a quality gate, score the night's new orders with it, and write a review queue at the fraud team's threshold, all from one job.

checks.label: Your job runs your scoring transformation (jb_nightly_screening.kjb names screen_orders.ktr)
Your training transformation saves the model (train_fraud_model.ktr calls h2o.save_model)
Your training transformation has its quality gate (train_fraud_model.ktr has an Abort step)
Your training transformation makes its features with your sub-transformation (train_fraud_model.ktr has a Mapping step)
Your scoring transformation loads the model (screen_orders.ktr calls h2o.load_model)
Your scoring transformation makes the same features with the same sub-transformation (screen_orders.ktr has a Mapping step)
Your job wrote the review queue (fraud_review_queue.csv in out\, with a fraud_probability column)
Your README.md in solution\ (how to run, schedule and read the job)
